```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| components: [editor, viewer]


library(shiny)
library(httr)
library(rvest)

# Base URL for the reports
base_url <- "https://alaskabirthdefectsregistry.github.io/ABDR_Quarto_Website/"

# Define the report links and their display names, grouped by category
# This structure mirrors the organization on the original website, but flattened
# for compatibility with Shiny's selectInput grouping.
report_categories <- list(
  "Rates and Trends" = list(
    "Prevalence Rates" = "Prevalence_current.html",
    "Prevalence Trends" = "trend_current.qmd"
  ),
  "Cardiovascular" = list(
    "Coarctation of the aorta" = "Coarctation_Aorta_tar.html",
    "Common truncus" = "Truncus_Arteriosus_tar.html",
    "Double outlet right ventricle" = "DORV_tar.html",
    "Ebstein anomaly" = "Ebstein_Anomaly_tar.html",
    "Hypoplastic left heart syndrome" = "HLHS_tar.html",
    "Interrupted aortic arch" = "IAA_tar.html",
    "Pulmonary valve atresia and stenosis" = "Pulmonary_Atresia_tar.html",
    "Single ventricle" = "SingleVentricle_tar.html",
    "Teratology of fallot" = "TOF_tar.html",
    "Total anomalous pulmonary venous Return" = "TAPVR_tar.html",
    "Transposition of the great arteries" = "TGA_tar.html",
    "Tricuspid valve atresia and stenosis" = "tricuspid_atresia_tar.html"
  ),
  "Central Nervous System" = list(
    "Anencephaly" = "Anencephaly_tar.html",
    "Spina bifida without anencephalus" = "SpinaBifida_tar.html",
    "Encephalocele" = "Encephalocele_tar.html"
  ),
  "Chromosomal" = list(
    "Trisomy 13" = "Trisomy13_tar.html",
    "Trisomy 18" = "Trisomy18_tar.html",
    "Trisomy 21 (Down syndrome)" = "Trisomy21_tar.html"
  ),
  "Eye" = list(
    "Anophthalmia/Microphthalmia" = "anoph_tar.html"
  ),
  "Genitourinary" = list(
    "Hypospadias" = "Hypospadias_tar.html"
  ),
  "Musculoskeletal" = list(
    "Clubfoot" = "club_foot_tar.html",
    "Craniosynostosis" = "Craniosynostosis_tar.html",
    "Diaphragmatic hernia" = "DiaphragmaticHernia_tar.html",
    "Gastroschisis" = "Gastroschisis_tar.html",
    "Limb Deficiencies" = "limb_tar.html",
    "Omphalocele" = "Omphalocele_tar.html"
  ),
  "Orofacial" = list(
    "Cleft Lip" = "cleft_lip_tar.html",
    "Cleft Palate" = "cleft_Palate_tar.html"
  ),
  "Other Syndromes" = list(
    "Fetal Alcohol Syndrome (FAS)" = "prenatal_alcohol_reportv3.html",
    "Neonatal Abstinence Syndrome (NAS)" = "nas_tar.html"
  )
)

# Transform the nested list into the format required by selectInput
# Each top-level list element will now be a group in the dropdown.
report_choices_grouped <- lapply(report_categories, function(category_list) {
  setNames(
    paste0(base_url, unlist(category_list)),
    names(category_list)
  )
})

ui <- fluidPage(
  # Add custom CSS to reduce text size in the sidebar
  tags$head(
    tags$style(HTML("
      /* Reduce font size for the dropdown label */
      .shiny-input-container label {
        font-size: 13px; /* Adjust as needed */
      }
      /* Reduce font size for dropdown options */
      .selectize-dropdown-content {
        font-size: 12px; /* Adjust as needed */
      }
      /* Reduce font size for the selected item in the dropdown */
      .selectize-input {
        font-size: 12px; /* Adjust as needed */
      }
      /* Reduce font size for h4 and p tags in the sidebar */
      .sidebar-panel h4 {
        font-size: 14px; /* Adjust as needed */
      }
      .sidebar-panel p {
        font-size: 11px; /* Adjust as needed */
      }
    "))
  ),
  # Application title
  titlePanel("Alaska Birth Defects Registry Reports"),
  
  # Sidebar with a dropdown selector
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 2, # Changed width to 2 (out of 12 columns) for a thinner sidebar
      selectInput(
        inputId = "reportSelector",
        label = "Choose a Report:",
        choices = report_choices_grouped, # Use the grouped choices
        selected = report_choices_grouped[[1]][1] # Select the first report in the first group by default
      ),
      h4("About This App:"),
      p("This Shiny application allows you to browse various reports from the Alaska Birth Defects Registry website. Select a report from the dropdown menu to view its content in the main panel."),
      p("Note: The content is embedded directly from the original website, so styling and functionality are maintained.")
    ),
    
    # Main panel for displaying the selected report
    mainPanel(
      width = 10, # The main panel will automatically take the remaining width (12 - sidebar_width)
      # Use an iframe to embed the external webpage
      # The height is set to fill most of the available space, adjust as needed
      htmlOutput("reportViewer")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$reportViewer <- renderUI({
    # Get the selected URL from the dropdown
    selected_url <- input$reportSelector
    
    # Create an iframe to embed the selected URL
    # Set width to 100% and height to a large value or dynamically adjust if possible
    tags$iframe(
      src = selected_url,
      width = "100%",
      height = "800px", # Adjust height as necessary for content
      style = "border: none;" # Remove iframe border
    )
  })
}

# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
